title: TCB checks and basic OK-status notes
summary: This topic mixes terse OK-status checks with a smaller set of negative TCB-related fault notes, so the examples do not form a single coherent customer issue.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention an unresponsive TCB and one faintly unfavorable comment about the vehicle's look.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are brief confirmations that checks, heating, or opening and closing functions were OK, without clear praise or complaint.

limitations: The cluster mixes unrelated subjects, including TCB diagnostics, appearance, heating, and door or flap operation.
Several examples are extremely brief status notes, which limits interpretation of customer intent or severity.
One negative-assigned review includes a diagnostic fragment marked undetermined at fragment level, so the exact complaint context is incomplete.
